Why (from proposal.md, not the design):
A factory Lightning Mesh router still needs a laptop and a hand-edited list peer on every box. The operator wants plug-in, wait, find nearby Lightning Mesh with no peer file. iroh already authenticates iroh traffic; it does not authenticate 802.11s or babel. Treating association as membership would let a stranger in RF range inject routes, poison claims, and reach overlay SSH. The product move is automatic discovery, not automatic trust.
What: Name capability identity-peering. Association is not authority. Unknown identities quarantine. Signed capability beacon is a locator not a ticket. Enrollment offer plus met QR. Control plane waits on quarantine + authenticated babel neighbor/session/freshness + identity-authorized CRDT writes. Trusted-fleet installs get full peer sets from fleet-nodes.conf. RF neighbors never ingested into list peer. Untrusted/incompatible degrade to isolated L3/NAT without overlay management.
